turns.content: yaar ajeeb sa scene ho gaya hai. Manav — mera school ka dost, chhe saal se saath reh rahe hain — woh shift ho raha hai, apni fiancée ke saath rahega. Baat theek hai, hona hi tha shaadi se pehle. Par mujhe yeh building ke WhatsApp group se pata chala. Owner ne pucha "flat mein naya banda kab aa raha hai?" Main wahin baitha tha. Mujhe usne bataya hi nahi tha ab tak.

Arre yaar... yeh toh sach mein ajeeb laga hoga. Flatmate chhe saal ka, aur pata WhatsApp group se? Woh baat hi alag hai.

Dekh, do cheezein ho sakti hain. Ek — shayad woh khud confuse tha, plan abhi finalize nahi hua tha, aur soch raha tha pehle pakka ho jaye phir batayega. Do — ya phir usse awkward lag raha tha bataane mein, kyunki tum dono ka equation badalne wala hai. Log aksar sabse close logon ko sabse last mein batate hain, ironically.

Par haan, jo feeling tum feel kar rahe ho — hurt hona bilkul valid hai. Yeh "move out" ki baat nahi hai, yeh "mujhse kyun nahi kaha" wali baat hai. Chhe saal ka saath hai, itni basic cheez expect karna normal hai.

Mera suggestion? Usse seedha baat kar, par blame tone mein nahi. Kuch aisa bol — "Yaar, group pe dekha, tu shift ho raha hai? Bata deta toh accha lagta." Dekhte hain woh kya kehta hai. Shayad uske paas koi wajah hogi jo tumhein samajh aa jaye... ya nahi bhi. Par at least tumhare paas clarity hogi, andhi andhere guess karne ke bajaye.

Aur ek baat — uski shaadi hai, nayi zindagi start kar raha hai. Ho sakta hai is transition mein uska dimaag ghar-girvi ho. Yeh excuse nahi hai, par context hai.

Kya lagta hai tumhe — woh jaan-boojh kar hide kar raha tha, ya bas taal raha tha?

phir raat ko usne casually bola "haan yaar batane hi wala tha, busy chal raha tha." Busy? Chhe saal ek kamre mein rahe hain, uski har cheez mujhe sabse pehle pata hoti thi. Uska rishta pakka hua toh main mithai leke uske ghar gaya tha. Aur ab main building group se pata karta hoon ki mera ghar khali ho raha hai.

Hmm... "busy chal raha tha" — yeh wahi line hai jo log tab bolte hain jab unke paas koi solid jawab nahi hota. Chhe saal mein kabhi busy nahi hua jo itni badi baat bata sake? Mithai wali baat tumne bilkul sahi pakdi — us waqt tumne uske khushi ko apni khushi maana, aur ab woh tumhe last mein sochta hai. Yeh asymmetry dard deti hai.

Par ek minute ruk. Do cheezein alag karke dekh:

Ek — woh careless hai ya woh tumse door ho raha hai? Careless hai toh baat karke theek ho sakta hai. Door ho raha hai — matlab nayi zindagi mein tumhara role badal raha hai — toh woh zyada gehri baat hai, aur usse "busy" se cover nahi hota.

Do — shaadi ke baad dostiyan badalti hain, yeh sach hai. Ho sakta hai uske dimaag mein yeh chal raha ho ki "ab main flatmate nahi raha, equation hi change hogi" — aur usne socha hi nahi ki tumhein kitna bura lagega. Log aksar apni transition mein itne doobe hote hain ki doosron ka hurt dikhta hi nahi.

Ab tumhare liye sawaal yeh hai: kya tumhein usse milna band karna hai? Mujhe lagta nahi. Tumne mithai leke jaane wala dil rakha hai — woh suddenly gayab nahi hota.

Toh ek baar, thoda seedha bol de: "Yaar, busy wali baat mat kar. Main building group se pata karoon ki mera ghar khali ho raha hai — yeh accha nahi laga mujhe." Bina gussa, par point clear. Uska reaction dekhna — woh samjhega ya defensive hoga? Wahi batayega ki aage kya hona chahiye.

Aur agar woh samajh jaye, maaf kar dena. Agar dismiss kare... phir sochna padega ki chhe saal ka rishta one-sided toh nahi tha.

Tumhein kaisa lagta hai — uski taraf se koi aur sign bhi hain aajkal, ya bas yeh ek incident hai?

It's fine. I have made my peace with it. People get married, people move on, priorities change. This is how life works. I will figure out the flat situation. It is not a big deal and I would prefer not to make it one.

Theek hai, samajh gaya. Aur honestly, yeh bhi ek valid jagah hai khade hone ki.

Bas ek choti si baat — "peace" aur "suppression" mein farak hota hai. Peace tab hota hai jab cheez sach mein process ho gayi ho. Suppression tab jab hum usse upar se patthar rakh dein taaki uthke na dekhein. Tumhare messages mein jo hurt tha, woh real tha — toh agar agli hafte kabhi achanak mood off ho, ya flat khali dekh ke ajeeb lage, toh khud ko mat bolna "maine toh peace kar liya tha." Feelings deadline follow nahi karti.

Aur haan — priorities badalti hain, yeh life hai, sahi kaha. Par tumhari taraf se mithai leke jaane wala dil bhi kam nahi hua. Woh wala version of you kahin nahi ja raha.

Flat ka scene sort kar lena, aur haan — agar kabhi bas aise hi baat karni ho, bina kisi point ke, main yahin hoon. All the best for the new chapter, yaar. 🤝

soch raha hoon usko bas itna reply kar doon — "Congratulations. I will start looking for a new flatmate from next week." Simple, clean, no drama. Usko bhi clear ho jayega aur mujhe bhi baar baar explain nahi karna padega. Theek hai na yeh?

Theek hai hai... par ek baat bolun? Yeh "simple, clean, no drama" wala reply actually thoda drama hi hai — bas packaged differently. "I will start looking for a new flatmate from next week" — yeh technically information nahi, yeh ek chhota sa message hai: *"tumne mujhe group se pata karwaya, ab main bhi formal ho gaya hoon."* Aur Manav jaisa banda, jo already guilty feel kar raha hoga, woh yeh turant pakad lega. Phir ya toh woh aur peeche hat jayega, ya tumhe "arre tu naraz hai kya?" wali conversation face karni padegi — jo tum avoid karna chahte the.

Agar sach mein no drama chahiye, toh do options:

**Option 1 — genuinely neutral:** "Congrats yaar! Flat ka scene main handle kar lunga, tension mat le." Warm, clean, koi undertone nahi. Isse tum bade niklo, aur woh khud apni galti feel karega — guilt uski, grace tumhari.

**Option 2 — tumhara wala, as is:** Bhej do, koi crime nahi hai. Par phir mentally ready rehna ki iska aftertaste hoga.

Mera dil kehta hai Option 1. Kyunki dekho — chhe saal mein tumne jo invest kiya, woh ek WhatsApp message se kam nahi hota. Usko cold reply dena tumhein thoda chhota karega, jabki tumhare andar ka banda mithai leke jaane wala tha.

Par final call tumhari hai. Kya lagta hai — agar kal ko socho, kaunsa reply tumhein zyada shanti dega?
